condition_evaluations.note: Condition evaluations, directed test assertions, unique cases, and repeated scenario observations are counted separately.

frozen_window_and_learning_checks.eligibility_definition: Actual SQLite applied target completion with at least three valid intervals, enabled personal policy, no fixed-days override, and outside its frozen displayed window. Counts are taken from the chronological repository trace; missing-window history is not treated as eligible input unless the actual published plan had no frozen displayed window.

raw_report_metric_caveat.reason: observed corpus events do not include frozen displayed-window snapshots; missing-window completions do not produce learning updates
raw_report_metric_caveat.source: reconciled per-case metrics against the actual SQLite operation trace; raw report was preserved unchanged

observation_and_learning.reach_three_definition: one target personal chore with at least three valid chronological SQLite completion intervals; seasonal, shared, fixed and non-target histories are excluded

definitions.fallback_plan_results_no_candidate: actual persisted plan_after.fallback === true from chronological SQLite trace
definitions.no_plan_results: actual trace rows with no plan_after; separated from no-candidate fallback results
